feature: FILM-1733 audience comments (read and kept within YouTube's 30 days, labelled by the server or the team's AI over MCP, shown with their states)

mutations.name: AC1 YouTube comments outlive 30 days
mutations.pattern: deletes every YouTube comment not returned for 30 days

mutations.name: AC2 a partial read deletes comments it did not reach
AC3 a channel without the permission is called anyway
mutations.pattern: does not call Instagram for a channel without the comment permission

mutations.name: AC4 shares from too few comments
mutations.pattern: gives no shares below 20 labelled comments

mutations.name: AC5 a video never read reads as no comments
AC6 the server writes a label for an id it did not send
mutations.pattern: writes only labels from the closed lists

mutations.name: AC7 a desktop AI labels another team's comment
AC8 a forged cursor reaches the filter
mutations.find:
commentedAt: z.string().datetime({ offset: true }),
  id: z.string().uuid(),
mutations.pattern: refuses a cursor it did not give

mutations.name: DB1 a person writes a comment
mutations.sql: grant insert, update, delete on public.audience_comments to authenticated; create policy audience_comments_write on public.audience_comments for all to authenticated using (true) with check (true);

mutations.name: DB2 a label names another team's comment
mutations.sql: alter table public.comment_labels drop constraint comment_labels_comment_account_fkey; alter table public.comment_labels add constraint comment_labels_comment_fkey foreign key (comment_id) references public.audience_comments (id) on delete cascade;
